title: PURSUE file: law enforcement officers report orbs and an orb mothership at a security site
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of PURSUE file: law enforcement officers report orbs and an orb mothership at a security site, about unspecified at National security site in the western US, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.
place_text: National security site in the western US

tellings.quote: there's this one report that came out about these law enforcement agents that are at a national security site somewhere uh in the west and they have all these interactions with orbs and one's even a mother ship of orbs that launches other orbs from it.

plain: A retired US Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a report he says is in a set of government records called the PURSUE files. According to Gallaudet, the report describes law enforcement agents at a national security site somewhere in the western US who had many encounters with glowing orbs, including one big "mother ship" of orbs that launched smaller orbs from itself. If true, it would mean strange objects are showing up at sensitive US sites and the government has written it down.
